content.hero.title: Every screen is a *fitting room.*
content.hero.lede: TryOn is a touchscreen mirror for your shop floor. Shoppers see the coat, the abaya and the frames on themselves before they buy, without queueing for a fitting room. Our cloud app runs the device and keeps your catalogue on it.
content.sections.how_it_works.label: How it works
content.sections.how_it_works.title: From the rail to *“it fits”* in four taps.
content.sections.how_it_works.lede: No app, no measuring tape, no queue for the fitting room. Shoppers walk up to the mirror in your store.
content.sections.features.label: On the shop floor
content.sections.features.title: The fitting room, *without the queue.*
content.sections.features.lede: One device on your shop floor, and our cloud app behind it. Shoppers try on everything you carry without waiting for a room, and you see which pieces they reach for.
content.sections.kiosk.label: The kiosk
content.sections.kiosk.title: The mirror that *sells.*
content.sections.kiosk.lede: A 55-inch touchscreen that stands where the fitting-room queue used to be. Shoppers try on the whole catalogue, including sizes that aren't on the rail, and take the look home on their phone.
content.sections.kiosk.install_line: Sold or leased, installed and calibrated by our team, for one store or a hundred.
content.sections.lookbook.label: Lookbook
content.sections.lookbook.title: Looks our shoppers *tried on* this week.
content.sections.lookbook.lede: Abayas in Riyadh, silk in Dubai, frames in London. A few of the ten thousand looks tried on today.
content.sections.lookbook.hint: Hover a look for before and after.
content.sections.lookbook.hint_touch: Tap a look for before and after.
content.sections.lookbook.all_note: Twelve cities, chosen from 71,400 try-ons this week.
content.sections.lookbook.footnote: Photos shown with permission. Try-on renders are generated in under two seconds.
content.sections.stories.label: Stories
content.sections.stories.title: Store owners, *in their own words.*
content.sections.stories.lede: An abaya house in Riyadh, an optician in Dubai, a boutique in Milan and a tailor in London, on their first season with TryOn.
content.sections.stories.footnote: Figures reported by each retailer for their first season on TryOn.
content.sections.pricing.label: Pricing
content.sections.pricing.title: One device. *Your way to own it.*
content.sections.pricing.lede: Every device comes with our cloud app. Our own team installs it in your store and calibrates it to your light and your floor.
content.sections.pricing.note: Prices per device, excluding VAT. Installation and calibration come with every device.
content.partners.title: From NLV to *the world.*
content.order.title: Your next customer is already *in front of a screen.*
content.order.lede: Leave your email and our team will call within one business day to confirm how many devices you need, the installation date, and getting your catalogue onto TryOn.
content.order.dialog_lede: Tell us about your store. Our team will call within one business day to confirm the devices, the plan and an installation date.
content.order.consent: NLV may contact me about this order and keep these details to handle it.
content.order.success_body: Our team will contact you within one business day to confirm your order and book the installation.
content.footer.statement: A try-on mirror for fashion and eyewear, *at home in any city.*
content.footer.tagline: Every screen is a fitting room.

faqs.question: What does the cloud app do?
faqs.answer: It runs the try-on on the device, keeps your catalogue up to date and shows which pieces get tried on and which get bought.

faqs.question: Do you keep customer photos?
faqs.answer: No. Photos are deleted when the session ends. A look is kept only if the shopper saves it to her phone.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: One visit. Our team installs and calibrates the device, and it is ready for shoppers the same day.
